tools.name: aspect_printing_service_links
tools.description: Return separate reference links for the print catalogue, artwork guidance, delivery and quotes. No enquiry is sent and no order is placed.

tools.name: colour_check_options
tools.description: Change the local preview for artwork already chosen by the user. Optional paper, PDF page, comparison view and highlight controls. Poll status until ready; only the selected PDF page is assessed.

tools.name: colour_check_sample
tools.description: Show the built-in sample only when no artwork is open. Does not upload or download a file. Poll colour_check_status for the result.

tools.name: colour_check_status
tools.description: Read the current page preview, settings and percentage of page area flagged. This is an estimate, not a print guarantee or percentage of colour change. No artwork or filenames are returned.
